quote.translation: Cournot asks whether the word chance corresponds to an idea with a density of its own, whether that idea has an object outside us and consequences that we cannot escape, or whether it is rather no more than a "breath of the voice" (flatus vocis), a deception to dress up our ignorance of the true causes.

quote.translation: His answer is "no": "No, the word chance is not something unrelated to external actuality.

regions.text: さうして否」と答へてゐる。「否偶然といふ語は外的現實性と無開係のものではない。

quote.translation: The word chance expresses an idea that is manifested within observable phenomena and has an efficacy that is taken into account in the governance of the world.

quote.translation: It is, that is, the idea of the actual independence (indépendance actuelle) and of the contingent encounter (rencontre accidentelle) of various chains or various series of causes" (Cournot, Matérialisme, Vitalisme, Rationalisme, p. 222).
Suppose that a meteorite falls in a white-hot state and makes a powder magazine explode.

regions.text: atiriaisme,Vitalisme,Rationalism,p.222）°限石が白熱狀態で落下して火薬庫を爆發させたとする。その場合火薬庫の爆發には偶然が奥ってゐる。なせならば、一方に、隕石が地球に對して進行して来る方向や、地球の表面の或る一定地點に落下することを決定するところの原因と他方に、將水隕石が落ちて来るべき地點にちやうを爆發物を蓄積するやうに決定した原因との間には何等の開聯がない。

quote.translation: Chance then has a share in the explosion of the powder magazine, since there is no connection whatever between the causes that determine the direction in which the meteorite advances towards the earth and its falling at a certain definite point on the earth's surface, on the one hand, and the cause that determined that explosives should be stored at exactly the point where the meteorite would one day fall, on the other.

regions.text: 火薬庫の代りに自然の硫氣孔または石油の發源地

quote.translation: We may equally suppose that, in place of a powder magazine, the meteorite fell on a natural solfatara or an oil source and set it alight.
